body: New api_memory.go: handleMemoryUpdate() patches named sections in emily-memory/world-state.md. Accepts {section, content} JSON body. Finds ### SECTION_NAME header, replaces content until next ### or ## heading. Registered in main.go mux. Emily Prime can now self-update world-state.md via HTTP after major milestones — makes her self-describing and self-updating across cold restarts.
title: S27-06: POST /api/v1/emily/memory/update endpoint live
